text.tspan: Friday, November 6, 2026 at 6:12 AM Coordinated Universal Time
A claim of next-id ST meets a stale lease, because another caller claimed first, and succeeds on the second try
Dynamic View: Factory Flow Control - ID Allocation
The project's git remote: origin, or
the URL that next-id gets with
the one ref with every ID sequence
checks the prefix against its fixed
prefix list, or the seed arguments;
origin; calls the counter port; prints
the ID or the seed lines on standard
output. The only caller of the counter
returns the next number of the prefix
that no other caller holds; seed
parentless claim commit with a new
token, pushes it with a lease on the
old SHA, and retries only on a stale
lease, at most ten times in a row
